beforeEverySend: sender verified and sending caps available
unsubscribe: immediate suppression of all pending starter-pack messages; no login required; provider-managed persistent suppression
end: sequence ends after day8; no automatic ongoing newsletter
recommendations: free public guides and existing free app entry only; no new paid product
tracking: open/click tracking off; separate consented pack-page measurement only
storage: durable provider-owned records; never process memory or ephemeral Vercel filesystem; no shared app database
activationRequired: explicit release and send activation decision
